proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemRecord + magic_item mechanics family
proposed_widenings.justification: UnitRecord in types.ts has no 'magic_item' kind. The tracer's exhaustive switch on unit.kind covers only spell | class_feature | mastery. A MagicItemRecord type and at least one magic-item mechanics family (charge-based activation) must be added before any magic item can be encoded.

proposed_widenings.name: daily_at_dawn recharge cadence (dice-based)
proposed_widenings.justification: The gem regains 1d3 charges daily at dawn. RestResetCadence only models short-rest and long-rest refills; no variant covers time-of-day recharge with a random dice amount.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The gem regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn.

proposed_widenings.name: magic_action activation cost
proposed_widenings.justification: Activation costs a Magic action (one of the 12 StandardActionKind values). ClassFeatureActivationCost only has 'free' and 'bonus_action'; a 'magic_action' variant is needed for magic items that consume the Magic action.
proposed_widenings.evidence: As a Magic action, you can expend 1 charge.

proposed_widenings.name: grant_sense effect (Truesight)
proposed_widenings.justification: The primary effect is Truesight out to 120 ft for 10 minutes. The v4 atom 'grant_sense' exists in TAXONOMY_atoms_graph.md but no corresponding TypeScript surface type exists in any Effect union (ClassFeatureEffect, Effect, ReactionEffect). A grant_sense variant with a sense kind, range, and timed duration is needed.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you have Truesight out to 120 feet when you peer through the gem

notes: Primary blocker is structural: 'magic_item' is entirely absent from UnitRecord. Even if that gap were closed, three surface-level variants are also missing: (1) a daily-at-dawn dice recharge cadence, (2) a magic_action activation cost, and (3) a grant_sense effect shape. The 'charge' resource atom is listed in v4 taxonomy but has no TypeScript surface representation; use_count with RestResetCadence cannot honestly model a dice-based time-of-day recharge. No honest coercion into SpellRecord or ClassFeatureRecord is possible.
